cues: During a power outage, residents gather in the lobby while maintenance staff inspect the building’s backup generator.
At the coastal station, researchers label water samples before storing them in a refrigerated cabinet.
After comparing several bids, the committee postpones its decision until every contractor submits revised estimates.
During the eclipse, volunteers distribute protective glasses beside the observatory’s crowded entrance.
At dawn, a delivery driver leaves insulated parcels beneath the awning of the closed neighborhood pharmacy.
